title: Claude doubles PDF token billing; Microsoft’s free Mark It Down fix #ClaudeAI #MarkItDown #AItools
description: Claude billed twice for every PDF page by converting each into an image plus text, causing excessive token usage. Microsoft released a free fix called Mark It Down that converts PDFs, Excel, and Word files cleanly into Markdown, eliminating image tokens and preserving headings and tables. This innovation reduces token consumption dramatically when using Claude, making document uploads more cost-effective and efficient. The tool also offers an MCP server for automatic file conversion in Claude, streamlining workflows and cutting needless overhead. Mark It Down improves user experience by maintaining document structure and minimizing charges, benefiting businesses and individuals relying on Claude for document processing. #ClaudeAI #MicrosoftMarkItDown #PDFtoMarkdown #TokenOptimization #AnthropicClaude #DocumentConversion #AItools #WorkflowAutomation #MCPServer #TokenCostReduction #DocumentProcessing
